subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage architecture now as a guarded shadow and authorization-gated path, or narrow/defer it until day-level parity improves?
rationale: The implementation is technically guarded, but accepting roughly 6,200 lines of parallel accounting architecture and deciding what evidence is sufficient for future authority promotion are product and maintenance choices that cannot be inferred from green checks alone.

options.title: Sponsor the guarded stack
options.body: Review and land all four PRs in order while preserving legacy default authority, explicit promotion authorization, containment, and rollback.

options.title: Take shadow-only pieces
options.body: Retain diagnostics, validation, and performance work but defer the authority selector and promotion contract until broader parity evidence exists.

options.title: Pause for more parity proof
options.body: Keep the stack unmerged until additional finalized ordinary-day and fork-heavy replays reduce uncertainty about daily attribution.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the guarded stack
recommendation.body: Review and land all four PRs in order while preserving legacy default authority, explicit promotion authorization, containment, and rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner reviewed and refined the current scanner containment path and is best positioned to weigh long-term architecture cost against accounting accuracy.
